questions.question: The given table shows the number of pages printed by four printers in three days. Days Printer L Printer M Printer N Printer O Friday 10,230 9,580 7,560 9,600 Saturday 8,540 11,230 6,580 7,890 Sunday 9,235 8,264 7,546 10,325 If the total number of pages printed by all the given printers together on Wednesday was 15% more than the total number of pages printed by all the given printers together on Saturday, what was the total number of pages printed by all the given printers together on Wednesday?
questions.questionHtml:
The given table shows the number of pages printed by four printers in three days.

Days Printer L Printer M Printer N Printer O
Friday 10,230 9,580 7,560 9,600
Saturday 8,540 11,230 6,580 7,890
Sunday 9,235 8,264 7,546 10,325

If the total number of pages printed by all the given printers together on Wednesday was 15% more than the total number of pages printed by all the given printers together on Saturday, what was the total number of pages printed by all the given printers together on Wednesday?
questions.solution:
Total pages printed on Saturday = 8540 + 11230 + 6580 + 7890 = 34240

Total pages printed on Wednesday = 34240 × (1 + 15/100) = 39376

questions.question: A pipe can fill an overhead tank in 12 hours. But due to a leak at the bottom, it is filled in 18 hours. If the tank is full, how much time will the leak take to empty it?
questions.questionHtml: A pipe can fill an overhead tank in 12 hours. But due to a leak at the bottom, it is filled in 18 hours. If the tank is full, how much time will the leak take to empty it?
questions.solution:
Rate of filling by pipe = 1/12

Effective filling rate = 1/18

Leak rate = (1/12 - 1/18) = (3 - 2)/36 = 1/36

Time taken by the leak = 1 ÷ (1/36) = 36 hours

questions.question: Let a + b = 2c, then which of the following expressions is true?
questions.questionHtml: Let a + b = 2c, then which of the following expressions is true?
questions.solution:
1. Substitute the given condition a + b = 2c into the expressions to verify which one is true.

2. Simplify both sides of each equation to confirm equality.

Verification:

Option 1: 4c² - 6bc + b² ≠ b² + 2bc (Not true)

Option 2: 4c² - 6bc + b² ≠ b² - 4c² + 2bc (Not true)

Option 3: 4c² - 2bc + b² = b² + 4c² - 2bc (True)

Option 4: 2c² - 3bc + b² ≠ b² - bc (Not true)

The correct answer is Option 3: a² + 2bc = b² + 2ac.

questions.question: If the equations 4x + (k - 2)y + 3 = 0 and (k - 2)x + 9y - 5 = 0 (k > 0) are parallel, then find the value of k 2 + 6.
questions.questionHtml: If the equations 4x + (k - 2)y + 3 = 0 and (k - 2)x + 9y - 5 = 0 (k > 0) are parallel, then find the value of k<sup>2</sup> + 6.
questions.solution:
4x + (k-2)y + 3 = 0

⇒ Slope = -(4)/(k-2) ⇒ (k-2)x + 9y - 5 = 0

⇒ Slope = -(k-2)/(9) ⇒(4)/(k-2) = (k-2)/(9)

4 ⋅ 9 = (k-2)2 ⇒ 36 = (k-2)2

⇒ k-2 = ±6 ⇒k = 8 (since k > 0)

k2 + 6 = 82 + 6 ⇒ 64 + 6 = 70

questions.question: If x, y and z are positive numbers and x + y + z = 1, then the least value of \(\frac{1}{x} + \frac{1}{y} + \frac{1}{z}\) is:
questions.questionHtml: If x, y and z are positive numbers and x + y + z = 1, then the least value of \(\frac{1}{x} + \frac{1}{y} + \frac{1}{z}\) is:
questions.solution:
Assume x = y = z

Since x + y + z = 1 ⇒ x = y = z = 1/3

Substitute values: (1/x) + (1/y) + (1/z) = 3 + 3 + 3

Least value = 9

questions.question: If \(\frac{sec \alpha + tan \alpha}{sec \alpha - tan \alpha} = \frac{7}{4}\) , then find the value of cosec α.
questions.questionHtml: If \(\frac{sec \alpha + tan \alpha}{sec \alpha - tan \alpha} = \frac{7}{4}\), then find the value of cosec α.
questions.solution:
(sec α + tan α)/(sec α - tan α) = 7/4 

4(sec α + tan α) = 7(sec α - tan α)  ⇒ 4 sec α + 4 tan α = 7 sec α - 7 tan α 

11 tan α = 3 sec α ⇒ 11 sin α = 3 

sin α = 3/11  ⇒ cosec α = 1/sin α = 11/3

questions.solution:

questions.question: What is the perimeter (in cm, rounded off to one decimal place) of the sector of a circle with a radius of 10 cm and of angle 30º? (Use π = 3.14)
questions.questionHtml: What is the perimeter (in cm, rounded off to one decimal place) of the sector of a circle with a radius of 10 cm and of angle 30º? (Use π = 3.14)
questions.solution:
Arc length = (30 / 360) × 2 × 3.14 × 10

Arc length = 5.233 cm

Perimeter = 2 × 10 + 5.233 ⇒ Perimeter = 25.233 cm

Perimeter ≈ 25.2 cm

questions.question: If 7845K854 is divisible by 11, then what is the value of K?
questions.questionHtml: If 7845K854 is divisible by 11, then what is the value of K?
questions.solution:
Sum of digits in odd positions: 7 + 4 + K + 5 = 16 + K

Sum of digits in even positions: 8 + 5 + 8 + 4 = 25

Difference: |(16 + K) - 25| = |K - 9|, For divisibility by 11: |K - 9| = 0

K = 9

questions.question: In a ΔPQR, the bisectors of∠Q and∠R meet at point O, inside the triangle. If∠QOR = 107º, then the measure of∠P is:
questions.questionHtml: In a ΔPQR, the bisectors of∠Q and∠R meet at point O, inside the triangle. If∠QOR = 107º, then the measure of∠P is:
questions.solution:
Given:

ΔPQR, bisectors of ∠Q and ∠R meet at O, ∠QOR = 107º

Formula: ∠QOR = 90º + (∠P / 2)

Calculation:

107º = 90º + (∠P / 2)

∠P / 2 = 17º ⇒ ∠P = 34º

questions.question: If \(\frac{7sin\theta + 4cos\theta}{9sin\theta - 2cos\theta} = \frac{5}{4}\) , then the value of \(\frac{tan^{2}\theta + 5}{tan^{2}\theta - 5}\) is:
questions.questionHtml: If \(\frac{7sin\theta + 4cos\theta}{9sin\theta - 2cos\theta} = \frac{5}{4}\), then the value of \(\frac{tan^{2}\theta + 5}{tan^{2}\theta - 5}\) is:
questions.solution:
From the equation: (7sinθ + 4cosθ) / (9sinθ - 2cosθ) = 5 / 4

Solving: tanθ = 26 / 17

tan²θ = (26 / 17)² = 676 / 289

Substitute into (tan²θ + 5) / (tan²θ - 5):

Numerator = (676 + 1445) / 289 = 2121 / 289

Denominator = (676 - 1445) / 289 = -769 / 289

Result = (2121 / 289) / (-769 / 289) = -2121 / 769

questions.question: A number is first increased by 12% and then increased by 23%. The number, so obtained, is now decreased by 34%. What is the net increase or decrease percent in the original number (nearest to an integer)?
questions.questionHtml: A number is first increased by 12% and then increased by 23%. The number, so obtained, is now decreased by 34%. What is the net increase or decrease percent in the original number (nearest to an integer)?
questions.solution:
Let the initial number be 100.

After a 12% increase: New Value = 100 × 1.12 = 112

After a 23% increase: New Value = 112 × 1.23 = 137.76

After a 34% decrease: New Value = 137.76 × 0.66 = 90.9216

Net change = 90.9216 - 100 = -9.0784

Net percentage change = (-9.0784 / 100) × 100 = -9.0784%

questions.question: A dishonest shopkeeper claims to sell salt at a rate of ₹25/kg. The cost price of the salt is ₹25/kg. Not satisfied with this, he tries to make profit by removing 200 gm from each kg. What is the shopkeeper's gain percentage?
questions.questionHtml: A dishonest shopkeeper claims to sell salt at a rate of ₹25/kg. The cost price of the salt is ₹25/kg. Not satisfied with this, he tries to make profit by removing 200 gm from each kg. What is the shopkeeper's gain percentage?
questions.solution:
Weight of salt sold per kg = 0.8 kg

Cost price for 0.8 kg salt = 25 × 0.8 = ₹20

Profit = 25 - 20 = ₹5

Profit Percentage = (5 / 20) × 100 = 0.25 × 100 = 25%

questions.question: A thief noticed a policeman at a distance of 600 metres. The thief started running and the policeman chased him. The thief and policeman are running at speeds of 12 km/h and 15 km/h, respectively. Find the time (in minutes) required for the policeman to catch the thief.
questions.questionHtml: A thief noticed a policeman at a distance of 600 metres. The thief started running and the policeman chased him. The thief and policeman are running at speeds of 12 km/h and 15 km/h, respectively. Find the time (in minutes) required for the policeman to catch the thief.
questions.solution:
Relative speed = 15 km/h - 12 km/h = 3 km/h

Convert to m/s: 3 × (5/18) = 5/6 m/s

Time = 600 m / (5/6 m/s) = 720 s = 12 min

questions.question: Find the area (in cm²) of the sector whose perimeter is 64/3 cm and central angle is 60º. (Use π = 22/7)
questions.questionHtml: Find the area (in cm²) of the sector whose perimeter is 64/3 cm and central angle is 60º. (Use π = 22/7)
questions.solution:
Given: Perimeter = 64/3 cm, θ = 60º

2r + (1/3) × (22/7)r = 64/3  ⇒ r = 7 cm

Area = (60/360) × (22/7) × 72  ⇒ ​ 77/3 cm2
